steps.note: R23 (design C2, N2 and N3). The off-duty agent is knocked out first (tipoff_source offduty), then Nightshade is accused to his face, which tips off nobody new. The tidy's reason is the KO, not the accusation. Phantom and Nightshade are punched after their interviews and left standing: Nightshade's confrontation line, the debrief line and the credits say so, and Phantom isn't called cleared unqualified.
